extension.description: Schema validation, completion and formatting for YAML and TOML, real terminal colours for ANSI logs, and F5 debugging for uv Python projects, with no language server or CLI to install.
config.yamlEnabled: Enable the YAML language server (validation, completion, hover, formatting). Syntax highlighting is unaffected.
config.tomlEnabled: Enable the TOML language server (validation, completion, hover, formatting). Syntax highlighting is unaffected.
config.tomlGrammarUpdateEnabled: Check once a week for a newer TOML TextMate grammar and download it in the background. An update takes effect after the window is reloaded. Turn this off to keep the bundled grammar and make no network requests for it.
config.tomlGrammarUpdateUrl: Source of the TOML TextMate grammar. Downloaded content is rejected unless it parses as JSON and declares the `source.toml` scope.
config.taplo: Settings handed to the TOML language server, in camelCase. See the [Taplo configuration reference](https://taplo.tamasfe.dev/configuration/file.html). A `.taplo.toml` file in the workspace takes precedence for the rules it defines.
snippet.taplo.exampleDetail: A schema catalog plus two formatter options
command.ansiPreviewToSide: Open ANSI Preview to the Side
debug.python.label: Python (uv)
debug.python.module: Module to run with `python -m`, instead of `program`.
debug.python.args: Command-line arguments passed to the program.
debug.python.cwd: Working directory. It also decides which uv project environment is used.
debug.python.env: Extra environment variables for the program.
debug.python.uvPath: Path to the uv executable. By default it is looked up on PATH and in common install locations.
debug.python.python: Interpreter that runs the program. Defaults to the environment resolved by `uv run`.
debug.python.justMyCode: Debug only your own code; skip the standard library and installed packages.
debug.python.stopOnEntry: Pause on the first line of the program.
debug.python.console: Where the program's input and output go.
debug.python.connect: Host and port of a process that is listening with debugpy.
